comment: Client is interested in a full smart-home package and flexible payment terms.
proposalText: We are delighted to present Canopy Hill Villa as an exceptional opportunity to own a signature hillside residence overlooking the Andaman Sea. Our team will accompany you through every stage of the purchase, from contract to handover, ensuring a seamless and transparent experience.

comment: Prefers a turnkey, fully furnished residence before Q1 handover.

comment: Requested a sustainability-focused build with solar and EV charging.
proposalText: We are pleased to propose Orchid Courtyard, a tranquil home designed around a reflecting pool and lush tropical garden. We would be glad to tailor the specification further to suit your long-term vision for the residence.

comment: Holiday home for the family; keen on the kitchen upgrade.
proposalText: We are excited to present Teak Rainforest Villa as the perfect family holiday retreat, secluded within private rainforest and finished in warm teak. Our team is on hand to assist with furnishing, rental management and any bespoke requests to make this a truly carefree second home.
